steps.body: Go to the exhibitor area of the app and fill in your profile completely. Add links to your careers page and social channels, a header image and further information.
steps.title: Complete your profile

steps.body: Best through the partner portal under “Contacts”: we create these team members through the interface, and the contacts they scan go to your company profile automatically. You can also add team members directly in the app — but only once they have personalised a ticket to their email address, and they have to turn on contact sharing themselves (step 4).
steps.title: Add your team

steps.body: Ideally every team member’s profile is filled in properly, so participants can see straight away who they are talking to.
steps.title: Complete your colleagues’ profiles

steps.body: Important: Team members added under “Contacts” in the partner portal are created through the interface — they share scanned contacts with your company profile automatically. Anyone added directly in the app has to turn on sharing contacts with the team in their own profile. Otherwise you will not be able to access those leads afterwards. The wiki explains how.
steps.title: Turn on contact sharing

steps.body: Under “Open roles” you can add positions. We recommend at most three, and ones that are appealing and representative. A traineeship or a project manager role speaks to a broad audience — very specific roles put people off at first.
steps.title: Post open roles

steps.body: The app goes live in mid-March. Under “Participants” you can then filter profiles by various criteria, among them field of study and work experience. Use it to identify suitable talent and reach out with a pointer to your presence. More tips are in the wiki under Event app.

After withdrawal the partner can no longer consider you for this format; data the partner has already downloaded is in the partner's responsibility.

talentSlides.emptyBody: Slides appear here after each session once the speaker shares them. You can see them with a ticket for this edition.
talentSlides.lead: Presentations that speakers have shared with participants — available after their session.
talentSlides.title: Slides after the summit
talentSlides.usageNote: These slides are for you personally. Please don't pass them on or publish them — the rights remain with the speakers.

talentStart.cardMineBody: What you are part of: applications, confirmations, registrations and tickets in one place.
talentStart.cardProfileBody: You keep your data once — it applies to every format and to matching.
talentStart.cardProgrammeBody: All sessions, masterclasses and formats. Apply and register while seats are free.

talentSummit.lead: Find the formats you can apply for and everything you're currently involved in.

talentTickets.emptyBody: As soon as you've bought or received a ticket and it's personalised to you, it appears here.
talentTickets.lead: Your summit ticket with the QR code for entry.
talentTickets.pending: Being issued. Once it's ready, your QR code appears here.
talentTickets.qrHint: Have it scanned at the entrance. The code is only valid for you — please don't share it.
talentTickets.title: Your tickets
talentTickets.walletHint: Opens your ticket at vivenu — that's where the Apple and Google Wallet buttons are.

testbetrieb.kurz: Data marked ZZTEST is test data.
testbetrieb.label: Test mode
testbetrieb.mehr: Only change or delete test data — everything else is real.

ticketBestaetigung.badgeHint: Printed on the badge. You can add it later in the portal.
ticketBestaetigung.emptyBody: This can take a few minutes. Reload the page shortly. If it stays empty, sign in with the email address you bought with.
ticketBestaetigung.emptyLead: We found nothing for your address on this order yet.
ticketBestaetigung.emptyWait: We are checking right now. Reload the page in a minute.
ticketBestaetigung.gateBody: Use the email address you bought with. We send you a sign-in link — no password needed.
ticketBestaetigung.gateLead: Sign in to complete your tickets.
ticketBestaetigung.holderEmailHint: The ticket goes there. The person signs in with this address and sees it in their portal.
ticketBestaetigung.holder_email_required: Please enter the person’s email address.
ticketBestaetigung.lead: Thanks for your purchase! This order includes {n} ticket(s). Tell us who is coming — the badge needs first and last name, company and position.
ticketBestaetigung.name_required: Please enter first and last name.
ticketBestaetigung.nextBody: Complete your profile and have a look at the programme — that is how you find the sessions that fit you.
ticketBestaetigung.nextDoneBody: Next, your profile and a look at the programme are worth your time.
ticketBestaetigung.noLinkLead: This link is incomplete. Open the page from the link after your purchase or check “Tickets”.
ticketBestaetigung.savedPortal: Saved. The transfer to the ticket provider follows automatically.
ticketBestaetigung.savedSynced: Saved. The details are also stored with the ticket provider.
ticketBestaetigung.skippedText: Still open — you can add it any time under “Tickets”.
ticketBestaetigung.title: Your tickets

titleAssistant.failed: The assistant is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes; your text stays.
titleAssistant.intro: Write a few sentences about what your talk is about. The more concrete, the better the suggestion.
titleAssistant.noModel: The assistant is not switched on yet. Talk to your buddy if you need it.
titleAssistant.placeholder: For example: it is about how supply chains become more transparent when suppliers maintain their own data instead of filling in questionnaires.
titleAssistant.placeholderNext: For example: shorter, and less like a consulting pitch.
titleAssistant.privacyNote: Only your slot's format and what you write here go to the assistant. No name, no organisation, no contact details.
titleAssistant.rateLimited: That is it for this hour — the assistant is capped at ten attempts per hour. Try again later.
titleAssistant.takeHint: This fills in the title and description above. Nothing is sent until you press submit yourself.
titleAssistant.taken: Copied into the fields. Submit to save it.
titleAssistant.teaser: You know what it is about, but not what to call it? Describe your content in your own words — we suggest a title and sharpen it with you.
titleAssistant.title: Stuck on the title?

tourAssignment.bookedEmpty: No partner with a company-tour booking in this edition yet.
tourAssignment.bookedLead: {n} partners have booked, {ohne} of them are not on any tour yet.
tourAssignment.errorBody: Reload the page; if the error persists, ask the architecture session.
tourAssignment.errorTitle: The assignment could not be loaded
tourAssignment.lead: Which partner is on which tour? A general company-tour slot is sold — the team decides the tour here and swaps when needed.
tourAssignment.swapHint: Swap: {name} — now choose the target stop.
tourAssignment.swapped: Swapped. The partners’ details moved with them.
tourAssignment.title: Tour assignment
tourAssignment.toursEmpty: No tours in this edition yet — “Create tours from the vocabulary” creates one per tour type.

travelList.adminLead: All speakers of the edition, sorted by arrival.
travelList.emptyBody: Nobody matches these filters. Clear one of them.
travelList.filterSearchHint: Name, organisation, train or flight number
travelList.leadLead: When your speakers arrive and leave again.
travelList.title: Arrival and departure

videos.emptyBody: Add one and embed it on a page through its key.
videos.expectedLead: If a link is missing, the page leaves the video out or says when it is coming. Add it with exactly this key and the page’s audience.
videos.fieldAudienceHint: Comma separated: partner, speaker, talent, volunteer, hackathon.
videos.fieldEditionHint: Leave empty if the video applies to every edition. An edition version beats the general one.
videos.fieldKeyHint: The page embeds through this, for example partner_tickets. Changing it removes the video from the page.
videos.fieldUrlHint: Loom only. The normal share link is enough — we work out the embed address.
videos.lead: Every embedded video in one place. Swapping a link here swaps the video everywhere that key is used.
videos.linkEmptyBody: Add a link with the key the page expects — for the event app event_app_app_store and event_app_google_play.
videos.linkKeyHint: The page reads through this, for example event_app_app_store. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
videos.linksLead: Addresses that pages link to rather than embed — first the event app store links for the participant programme and the partner portal. Pages read them by key; changing a link here changes it everywhere. One exception: the 3D tour of the summit (partner_3d_tour, audience Partner) is embedded in the partner portal when it is a Matterport address (https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=…), otherwise linked.
videos.title: Videos

volunteers.applied: Your application has arrived. We will be in touch.
volunteers.areasHint: Where would you like to help? Pick as many as you like.
volunteers.areasPending: The areas for 2027 are not set yet. We will ask as soon as the list is ready.
volunteers.availabilityHint: One sentence is enough, for example „Friday only from 12“.
volunteers.birthdateHint: We only use it to check the minimum age.
volunteers.buddyHint: Name of the person you would like to be scheduled with.
volunteers.consentLead: Without consent to the terms and the privacy notice we cannot accept the application.
volunteers.declineBody: We will move someone up from the waiting list. Feel free to tell us briefly why.
volunteers.inviteAccepted: You are on the volunteer team. Your shifts are in the volunteer area.
volunteers.inviteApplied: Your volunteer application is under review. We will get back to you with the confirmation and your shifts.
volunteers.inviteBody: Volunteers make the summit happen — two days behind the scenes, with a shirt, food and a ticket.
volunteers.inviteTitle: Want to help at the summit?
volunteers.lead: Apply as a volunteer and keep track of your shifts.
volunteers.leadEmptyBody: As soon as the team names you as the lead of a shift, your people show up here.
volunteers.leadLead: Your shifts and who is on them.
volunteers.personLead: One detail up front: volunteers must be 18 on the first day of the event.
volunteers.prefsLead: Everything here is a preference, not a commitment — the team does the scheduling.
volunteers.safetyLead: This applies to all volunteers. Without your confirmation you cannot confirm a shift.
volunteers.safetyPoint1: Emergency exits and escape routes stay clear at all times. Your team shows you where they are at the briefing.
volunteers.safetyPoint2: In an emergency, call the operations lead first, then the emergency number if there is danger. Numbers are in the briefing.
volunteers.safetyPoint3: You only work where you are assigned and wear your volunteer badge visibly.
volunteers.safetyPoint4: Heavy loads, ladders and equipment only after instruction by the area lead.
volunteers.shiftsEmptyBody: Scheduling is under way. We will write as soon as your first shift is set.
volunteers.shiftsLead: Confirm your shifts so we can plan reliably.
volunteers.shiftsLockedBody: Once your application is accepted, your shifts show up here.
volunteers.shiftsNoProfileBody: Apply as a volunteer first — then we will schedule you.
volunteers.statusBody_accepted: You are in. As soon as the plan is set, your shifts appear here in the portal.
volunteers.statusBody_applied: We look at every application and get back to you with the confirmation and your shifts.
volunteers.statusBody_declined: It did not work out this time. We would be glad to see you apply again.
volunteers.ticketHint: Enter the code in the shop. One code, one ticket — please do not pass it on.
volunteers.ticketLead: One code for you. Your spot is confirmed once you redeem it.
volunteers.ticketPending: You are in — your code arrives within the next few hours. We will let you know.
volunteers.ticketRedeemedBody: Your ticket is in your inbox. See you soon!
volunteers.title: Volunteers
volunteers.tooYoung: You need to be 18 on the first day of the event.
volunteers.waitlistHint: You are on the waiting list. If a place opens up you move up automatically and we will write to you.
volunteers.wishLead: Pick at least one and at most {max} shifts. The order of your picks is your ranking. The team does the scheduling; a preference is not a promise.
volunteers.wishNone: No shifts to choose from yet. Once the team has created them you can pick here.
volunteers.withdrawBody: Your application is withdrawn and you will not be scheduled. You can apply again later.

wiki.adminLead: Articles per audience, overlay per edition.
wiki.audienceRequired: Required: the category decides who sees the article and what the assistant answers. Without it, it reaches no one.
wiki.boldHeadingHint: Bold line meant as a heading? Mark it with ###: “{text}” (line {zeile}).
wiki.differs: The two language versions differ in audience, topic or phase. Saving aligns them.
wiki.editorHint: Format with the toolbar or write Markdown directly. The preview shows how the article looks in the portal. Headings: ## for a section, ### for a subsection, no deeper. Phrase it as a question if the section answers one, otherwise as a noun or a short phrase — without a colon, brackets or a number.
wiki.emptyAdminBody: Create the first article — slug, audience, title.
wiki.emptyBody: As soon as the team publishes articles, they appear here.
wiki.fieldProductsAll: No format selected: the article applies to all partners.
wiki.fieldProductsSome: The article only appears in the partner portal for partners who booked a product of this format.
wiki.fieldTopicHint: The article is listed under this topic in the portal.
wiki.lead: Answers to what gets asked again and again.
wiki.missingLanguage: This language version does not exist yet — saving creates it as a draft, and it only appears in the portal once you publish it.
wiki.noResultsBody: No article matches this search and these filters. Try fewer words or clear the filters.
wiki.overlayHint: Without an edition the article applies every year. With an edition it overrides the evergreen article of the same slug.
wiki.partnerFilterNote: Here you find the general articles and those for the services you have booked. For anything else, ask your contact person.
wiki.republished: Published again — the article is live in the portal.
wiki.sharedBody: Applies to German and English at once — so the audience never differs between languages.
wiki.slugHint: The article's address, e.g. “booth-setup”. It cannot be changed later.
wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.topicHint: Pick the topic in the article. Articles without a topic appear under “More articles” in the portal; the product link hides articles from partners without a matching booking (relevance, not access control).

wikiAssistent.noHit: Chefi finds nothing about that in the wiki.
wikiAssistent.privacy: Please don't enter personal data. Chefi stores questions without names so we can improve the wiki. The conversation itself stays in this browser tab only.
